notice: Derived extraction; authentication, transport envelopes and payload staging omitted. Original hash is in the disposition manifest. Device output is an observation, not proof of emitted light.

observations.command:
date -u
cat /proc/uptime
ls -l /proc/config.gz /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/available_filter_functions /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/kprobe_events /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/uprobe_events
cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/raw_syscalls/sys_enter/format
cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/i2c/i2c_write/format
cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/drm/drm_vblank_event/format
cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/regulator/regulator_disable/format
cat /proc/kallsyms | grep -Ei 'QDFTcon|tcon_.*(power|mute|status|low|err|lock)|frc_.*(power|mute|reset)|ave_.*tcon' | head -n 180
ls -l /lib/modules
find /lib/modules -name 'sdp_drm.ko' -o -name 'sdp_frc.ko' -o -name 'sdp_pqe_dp.ko' -o -name 'rosem_frc.ko' -o -name 'tztv_frc_tcon_api.ko'
ls -l /sys/kernel/debug/dri/0/crtc-0 /sys/kernel/debug/dri/0/LVDS-1
observations.stderr:
ls: cannot access /proc/config.gz: No such file or directory
ls: cannot access /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/available_filter_functions: No such file or directory
ls: cannot access /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/kprobe_events: No such file or directory
ls: cannot access /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/uprobe_events: No such file or directory
cat: /proc/kallsyms: No such file or directory
